caption: The drawing features a single, vertically-oriented object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object consists of three main sections: at the base, there are three stacked geometric wooden blocks, each with a roughly hexagonal shape and painted in alternating faded red and green hues, showing signs of wear and aging. Emerging from the top of this stacked base is a thin, vertical, metallic-looking rod. At the upper end of the rod is an intricately decorated cylindrical element, which is predominantly brown and gold in color and embellished with ornate, raised patterns that include curvilinear and floral motifs. The composition is simple, with the object taking up most of the vertical space in the image, and there are no other elements present except for a small, unobtrusive artist’s signature in the lower right corner.
title: Receptacle for Peanut Oil
